Definition: from G931; to torture:--pain, toil, torment, toss, vex.
BiblicalUsage: Basanizo means to torment, to torture, to toss as a ship is tossed by waves. The devils beg Jesus not to torment them before the time, the disciples' ship is tossed in the wind on the sea, the woman in travail is tormented in her labour, and the devil is cast into the lake of fire to be tormented day and night forever.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this word runs from the devils' fear to the devil's end, because the same torment they dreaded is the torment they will suffer. They knew the time was coming, and I hold that their begging proves what the lake of fire confirms: judgment is real, and it is forever.
